title: Fractal functions defined in terms of number representations in systems with a redundant alphabet
summary: For fixed natural numbers $r$ and $s$, where $2\leq s \leq r$, we consider a representation of numbers from the interval $[0;\frac{r}{s-1}]$ obtained by encoding numbers by means of the alphabet $A=\{0,1,...,r\}$ via the expansion $x=\sum\limits_{n=1}^{\infty}s^{-n}α_n=Δ^{r_s}_{α_1α_2...α_n...}.$ The algorithm for expanding a number into such a series is justified in the paper.
